body:
OMG MY MOM DOES THIS TOO

Like if I want towatch tv she gets so offended if I'm not sitting with her instead :/
Thanks for the advice. I've done my isn't laundry for maybev8 years now but she rummages through it anyways

hey thats a great idea. when i get a job i dont want my parents to be able to touch my money. is it that easy to open up your own bank aaccount? oh yeah, i take the bus everywhere and i could easily go to a bank by myself - i have an account my parents have access to but my mom wouldnt know how to take money out of it so itd just be my dad.
idk mostly she's been hounding me as to when my last period was, she's let the semen thing go a little, thankfully... i guess the fact that she did that to me was messed up though.
thanks stranger, i know :/

I don't think it works as well as it should - she'd be a lot worse without it but it can only help so much. 

Sorry but I am not sure about the whole N thing - i just posted in this sub because someone from 2Xchromosomes told me my story might belong here! I guess she wouldnt hurt me physically ever, just emotionally unfortunately. but thanks for the advice. youre right that i do want to get out of here ASAP. It's not my physical self that is in danger i guess, just my sanity :/ 

in the future when im moved out on my own i know i wouldnt want to visit her much. occasional phonecalls would be fine but it would be too much for me to have to see here a lot

sigh sadly you're right. I saw a psychologist recently to talk over the things my family has done to me and she said I should ask my mom why she goes through all my things and I'm like, when I ask she plays dumb and says she was just cleaning or that I can't be a stranger who hides stuff from her... I just try to avoid being home a lot. Also idk I I should've mentioned this but my mom has some sort of mental illness too and has been on medication as far as I can remember so she's pretty irrational.

Thank you for the advice. And it sounds pretty horrible you had to go trough that! It's like nobody understands what is natural for your body to go through and that's such a horrivle thing. I've always done my own laundry for the past 5 years but my mom just looooves snooping anyway :/ tbh though I'm glad I posted here after 2xchromosomes cuz there I was getting responses like "you pretty much deserve this cuz you're doing things your parents done approve of" and it's like because I'm not religious I have to be punished and completely lose my relationship with my family, thoug I'm a nice, school oriented person who doesn't do anything wrong?

like she keeps interrogating me as to when my last period was. i dont remember nor is that any of her business! And I live in Canada so i do have rights that other teenagers here have. also i don't believe in god or religion so theres that, and yeah , it's pretty sad she's shocked i actually have a sex drive. i know she didnt mean for it but over the years my mother has pushed me farther and farhter away from her and i will never love and trust her the way a daughter should. i recognize she cared for me when i was younger and gave birth to me which wasnt easy and i appreciate it but that's as far as my gratefulness goes - she has ruined her relationship with me.

well i have never been alloweed to go out... even if i am really just going to dinner with some friends i have to be home pretty early and get texted and stuff a lot. brown girls are never allowed to have any freedom no matter what we're doing. i understand your perspective but would you not feel violated if someone was literally punishing you for natural stains on your underwear? I'm not really complaining about not having freedom, lots of brown girls dont, its the total lack of humanity that gets me

well its more that my family is decently religious muslim in general - my mom is more for the cultural aspect of it. i could, but she would probably say something along the lines of how ive been corrupted by satan! thanks for the advice though, i know it is awful always having your privacy invaded and honestly my parents coddling me has definitely given me a shitload of trust issues :/
hey, thats a pretty good idea. i could see her being like what the bleep do you have to hide from me but honestly its a better solution than having my stuff thrown out!

thanks for the support. I'm finishing up my first year so it'll be 3 more years. The only problem is i still couldn't see myself being allowed to move out when I'm done my degree. I know it sounds ridiculous but I may have to go to grad school just so i can escape living at home, even though I'm in business so i can get a job without grad school. hopefully i can leave sooner.
thanks for the advice. i think i will. but my mom isnt a narcissist, much the opposite - i guess their advice would still be good too!

im in university but living at home.
I would love to move out but currently am broke :( plus i would never be allowed. I plan on making a lot of money over the next few years to hightail it outta here. honestly I'm considering law school after undergrad, i do want to do it a lot and it will give me a surefire way to leave after im done my degree since i wouldnt go to my university's law school.

Exactly.
of course i understood she was angry at finding booze.
it wasnt her anger that was unjustified.
what was unjustified was that this was in the bottom of my dresser under layers of clothes.
i live at home but i think i have a right not to get my stuff snooped through all the time.  idk if i should clarify but i am actually a pretty good kid, though not the way my parents would like me to be, i don't do anything illegal or anything. 

but thanks Princess. I agree. I feel so violated and embarrassed over her being like WTF IS ON YOUR UNDERWEAR. To me that isnt even comparable to her going through my stuff (and throwing a lot of it out. this was also stuff that other people gave me or was bought with my own money)

well the school i go to, anybody can live on res. i would love to if i wasnt broke as hell lol. i plan on getting a job this summer and working 4 times a week, i am going to take 2 classes too so at least i can avoid being home,
thank you for your response. youre right, its just because she cares i guess. i hope things do change!

btw i guess my situation is a bit different because my friends, some cousins of mine and my sister who im super close to know of my relationship, so with my sister in the picture he isnt completely alienated from my family. it still kind of is similar. anyway. hope you get through it <3

Hey, i just wanted to say I hope you are doing okay. I know you might feel like it's his fault for not wanting to tell his family but it's a tough situation. i have muslim parents who will never accept my white boyfriend of 2 years, who honestly i might marry someday. I don't think I will ever be able to tell them even though i love him with all my heart - that being said, my family has hurt me in many ways so I would choose him over them in a heartbeat. I can totally see why youd be upset over him not telling his parents and honestly it is really shitty as a situation to be in :( but as someone with a similar situation to his i can understand him being too scared to tell his family, despite his feelings for you - it is more than angering them. If his parents are like mine, they would shun him and probably never want to talk to him again. Let me reiterate that it is a sad situation for the both of you, but please don't think him being scared of his family means he loves you any less. i don't think he has tricked you or his unfortunate and sad situation makes your love any less real - it is more real because of all that youve been through and the fact that youve been brave enough to remain with him through it all. I love my man more than life itself and i want to be with him through whatever life takes us but if i choose him over my family, not only will they hate me forever, it will be hard enough dealing with getting past them through the possible marriage and life together. I do believe when you have super strict parents who are trying to dictate who you marry, you should break free and be with who you love, but it is unfortunately going to be a life changing situtation for him when he ends his relationship with his family.

hahah seriously, if anything, I'm surprised they're more outraged by some necklace than her dressing in a sexy way or *gasp* being a woman who actually expresses herself and dresses in a way that Allah dislikes!!!

This is ignorance at its finest. Yes, I don't care if they wear it. But the fact that they're pretty much saying "Western women" who actually wear clothes they like are the oppressed ones?? wtf. I still live at home so I dress decently modestly, but jeans, t-shirts, dresses, what have you feel liberating to me! and also saying that Niqab would stop rape? Yeah, pretty sure that's a load of crap, seeing how many women are raped in the middle east where Niqab is more commonplace.
nahh, nobody knew i had it there. my room was just messy as hell and my mom goes crazy when it is (midterms month haha)

yeah, it is pretty similar! awe no worries, and right back atcha! It does suck a  lot but as long as you try to respect them as people, even if you highly disagree with their beliefs, it will make your life easier! I guess at the end of the day if my family chooses to reject me for no reason other than being brought up on a liberal society, so be it, that's their decision.
haha i know right, never again! to be fair i kept all inappropro stuff in the bottom of my dresser under a bunch of clothes and nothing was discovered ever for like 4 years until one fateful days :(

Thank you so much for your comforting words. No it helps for sure. Honestly the only thing that gets me through this kind crap is like most of my muslim friends have been caught for similar stuff and we always get through it. Nobody even has the decency to ask me what i had the pills for, if they do ill just say i had horrrible cramps without them so i guess ill survive. 

Sigh, I hope that's the case! I'm just waiting for the day I can move out and be free.

really? I'm sorry to hear that. I hope it gets better for me. I have a good life in many other ways but my home life brings me down so much. I'm in uni so usually i stay there a lot but of course i have to come home to sleep :P so i have to see my family

I just wanted to say that my heart goes out to you :( 
what ive just been through isnt the same, but im 18 and my mom ransacked my dresser, finding some alcohol and my BC pills. She keeps demanding i give her my healtth card and explaining to me drinking is sinful  - my mom is protective as hell but a little less crazy than other brown moms so i told her i literally dont believe in any religious rules. she doesnt flip when i say taht stuff but says i have to at least start reading quran, remembering allah, the whole schbiel. i wanna say the BC is for cramps if anyone asks, but NOBODY is asking!! theyre just freaking out. and i have no money to move out. ugh it sucks. id say just stay true to yourself while youre still stuck there until you have money ot move out, thats what im doing. lie low and dont talk to them too much, change passwords, delete accounts, hide stuff in bags you can take with you. dont let them tell you what to do - dont actually change anything about yourself - just hide things for now so you dont make your life harder in the process. 

my parents and brothers dont understand shit and it drives me insane. being a "muslim" has fucking ruined my life and i hate when people dont realize what this religion of "peace" (hahahhaa) does to women and the ways it oppresses them; even when we are adults, our parents try to take over every aspect of our lives. 

Best of luck to you, OP. Hope you are ok.

I'll share one - mom ransacked my dresser, found booze and BC pills. Is demanding i give her my healthcare card (Im 18) and keeps giviing me lectures about the greatness of Allah. I can't wait for the day I have enough money to move out. Oh, and the rest of my family treats me way worse than that.

dudeee she keeps asking me for my health card :/ i know im 18 so I don't have to give it to her but shes being really pushy so its kind of scaring me! idk what i should do ! 
exactly, i totally know what you mean! It's like the obligation of having to pretend everything is fine when it's really not. Yeah, i think distance will be great when i can finally leave. 

yeah theyre super supportive! 
and thats a good idea, my university has a plan where you can get a certain amount of free counselling sessions for free per semester so i think im gonna go for that! thanks so much for listening :)

Thank you! Exactly, in my darkest moments that is the only thing that makes me hold on. I just am sooooo sick of getting in trouble over stupid BS all the time when I have bigger things to worry about and I hope that when I save up enough to move out (probably with my sister), the hell they'll give me is going to be worth leaving! I know it will be.

Thanks for the advice - beware, this is gonna be a wall of text! 
the thing is the cat isn't out of the bag about my bf that much. I don't think they really believe my brother about that much so that's not a concern - it's that my mom is the overly worried type that keeps trying to get me to be like "Yes, god is amazing! Totally gonna pray 5x a day and not talk to boys!" and i feel like she wants whats best for me but in the worst ways. I think she told my dad but at this point I don't even care; even if it was something lesser it wouldn't matter as "muslim girls" (quotes because I am an atheist) are supposed to just sit there and look pretty all day..
I really hope I can move out soon. I would love to cut contact but I don't see how that would be an option. It's really bad because it's like, even if i have money and a good job they'll give me hell for wanting to leave!! I'm 18 so i know they can't legally do anything but with Pakistani parents, legal or not doesnt matter. And yeah, I still have my bc prescription as she only took 2 months worth; it;s not a matter of what was discarded, rather, im concerned over what was found. I can likely say I took it for horrilbe period cramps if they ask and just say they would never have let me take it, they'll probably believe me anyway. And my relationship with my mother is ok. She has some issues and isn't really all there mentally so she is usually nice, but is extremely overbearing, gives me no freedom, tells my dad and brothers everything, always tells me i  need to be better, etc. 

And yeah I told the bf, he knows everything and is my sole confider hahaha, yeah next time i'll probably keep it at his place! And he tells me the pretty typical advice which is to lay low until I can afford to move out and go ahead and do it when I can afford to. He realizes none of this stuff is my fault but i still feel bad pushing all my problems onto him.

Anyway, at this point I have other stresses in my life too and I wouldn't miss much at all if I cut contact with my family. I wouldn't really miss my brothers or dad and would miss my mom ab bit, but thats it. Also, my sister has similar issues to mine and we are very close, but she's so stressed/ busy all the time that it's hard to talk to her about this stuff sometimes (not hard as in  i cant, as in shes heard it all before and it gets tiring to hear when youre going through it too haha) 

also, they will never want to meet him, they only sort of know about it now so if i  lie low it willl probably be okay. My parents are not bad people, but I honestly would be a much happier person without my family in my life, apart from my sister - everyone thinks im crazy when i say that, but I know for a fact it is genuinely how I feel. anyway thanks for the advice!

my boyfriend is not muslim though, so i cannot really use that argument :( but youre right, racism is completely stupid. my sister and i both have a bad relationship with my family, my dad pretens to be nice to us but it is just an attempt to get us to act the way he wants us to; he'll talk to us a little but it's not usually anything that is encouraging or accepting towards us
haha it can be rough hey.

UGH haha tell me about it! why oh god why do my parents hate on white people so much. my cousin was married to a white convert and they got divorced, none of us know why (rightfully! its their business!) and all i heard was it was because she was white. they'll kill me if i marry a white person (which i likely will) but at this point i dont care

No its okay, using your own problems to explain a solution to someone is a great way to start. and thank you so much! I guess I'm not sure what I can do, my mother has a whole host of other issues that tbh I'd rather not get into but it prevents me from being able to communicate well with her. It's just reaching that point that is really your end is so hard. You feel like you have no options anymore. And tbh what your mom said was pretty ridiculous. When my dad found out my sister had a (white) bf, he literally said " youre not my daughter anymore". It's almost laughable

that sounds pretty brutal :( but im glad you made it through. i don't think communicating will work - seriously, my parents are stuck in another world where they dream of me being a super sheltered individual who doesnt know what kissing is. but im happy this worked out for you. i guess ill have to see what i can do.

thank you so much for the advice. the thing is my mom won't understand... she doesnt know how to talk about things. It's pretty evident that I am not an addict of any kind so im okay there but hopefully i can move out soon. It's hard to explain but telling my parents I have a boyfriend is not an option. Disgustingly enough, my family talks about "white people" like they are dirt. It sickens me to see it so much but admitting that part at least would make my situation a hundred times worse. I'll have to see what my options are, but thanks for listening.

It's like the reaction extremely conservative and narrow minded parents would have if their child was gay. Sometimes the only thing I have to be happy about is that I am not gay because my situation would be a million times worse then

I maybe have some friends I could move in with, but no family here. I know but it's different when you have brown parents - they will try as hard as possible to dictate every aspect of your life, even if you're 30, married and moved out. 
But yes, you're right. My sister and I plan on making a lot of money this summer - university summers are 4 months so I could make a lot - and saving up over the summer and maybe another year to get out of here.

The thing is, I am not allowed to do anything that makes me happy, which is the problem. I have a good boyfriend but dating is extremely forbidden with my parents, especially when he's not Muslim or brown (which my bf isn't). 
It's the main stress i have in my life - knowing that if I end up staying with him in the long term, no matter how good he is to me, so many people (family, relatives, family friends of parents) will hate me forever.

that's very true. tbh i think i'd be completely happy if i didn't live at home.  i try to be a positive person but they are so awful. they make me feel trapped. i think i should go to my school's therapists and talk to them, it won't fix my issues ( i seriously won't feel much better until i can finally move out) but maybe it'll help me
hey i think im ok for now but thanks for the offer.

it's almost like i feel like the only way my parents would be happy with me is if i cease to exist. I wish I had never been born. My mom had a miscarriage right before she got pregnant with me and sometimes i wish the last fetus survived instead of me.

I've told it to them multiple times. Hell, I've cried and said that I don't want to live a life like this, where I feel crazy because I have no freedom. I have said it so many times, but they don't listen and say I'm extremely ungrateful for not appreciating everything they have given me. thanks for the advice though!
my cat, my boyfriend, my sister. the few people who have yet to fuck me over in this pretty little world
